temperature_3d.units_interpretation: Nominal NetCDF units; displayed as °C (typical lake T magnitude).

temperature.units_interpretation: Nominal NetCDF units; displayed as °C (typical lake T magnitude).

dimensions.description: Horizontal curvilinear grid; flow stagger averaged to cell (M,N).
dimensions.depth_axis: depth_m, derived as abs(ZK_LYR); use nearest layer for requested depth.

crs_and_alignment.summary: Model horizontal coordinates XZ, YZ are in the Delft3D-FLOW horizontal plane (CF axis: XZ positive east, YZ positive north; see file attributes). Fiber geometry from Situation.h5 / situation.json is exported in CH1903+ / LV95 (large easting/northing, ~1e6 m). No verified affine or control-point mapping between these frames is stored in this repository.
crs_and_alignment.overlay_feasibility: Map rasters are written in model native XZ,YZ. Georeferenced overlay on LV95 bathymetry requires an external or future transform.

fiber_timeseries.arrays: time_s only; u_ms, v_ms, thermocline_m along fiber are shape (Nt, 0) until a verified model↔LV95 mapping exists.
fiber_timeseries.reason: Interpolating environmental fields onto fiber requires shared coordinates. Repository does not yet contain a validated transform.

processing: UMNLDF/VMNLDF: staggered components averaged to (M,N) per environmental_data_audit.md.
Rotation to east/north via ALFAS when present; else grid-aligned u,v exported.
THERMOCLINE: values equal to -999.0 masked to NaN (exported as thermocline_t; sparse).
UMNLDF/VMNLDF are all zero in this file; using U1/V1 at vertical index k=68 (auto-picked wet layer; values with |U| or |V| ≥ 998 masked as dry).
Time window clipped to 2022-01-25T00:00:00+00:00 inclusive through 2022-01-28T00:00:00+00:00 exclusive; kept source indices 16..39 (24 of 56 timesteps).
ALFAS applied: exported u_ms/v_ms are east/north components.
Depth-enabled export: wrote R1 temperature for all available vertical layer centres (temperature_zt with depth_m from ZK_LYR, sorted shallow to deep).
Depth-enabled export: wrote U1/V1 currents for all available vertical layers (u_face_zt/v_face_zt).
Primary scalar: R1 (NAMCON=temperature) layer k=68, aligned with wet-layer heuristic used for U1/V1. Dry/land masked at -999. File attribute units are nominal; viewer labels °C.

outputs.environmental_map_fields.npz: Keys: XZ, YZ (M,N), time_s (Nt,), u_face_t, v_face_t, temperature_t (Nt,M,N) primary scalar, thermocline_t secondary; model plane.
outputs.environmental_fiber_timeseries.npz: Keys: time_s (Nt,); along_m (0,); u_ms, v_ms, thermocline_m (Nt,0) until CRS resolved.

mvp_scalar.rationale: R1 temperature at the wet vertical layer has much higher horizontal coverage than THERMOCLINE in the audited 20220123 file; thermocline remains exported as a secondary diagnostic.

requested_time_window_utc.purpose: Thesis dashboard focus window covering 2022-01-25 through 2022-01-27.

viewer_hints.default_time_index_note: Among steps with R1 temperature coverage coverage ≥13.8% (max 39.5%), closest to thesis whale-window UTC.
viewer_hints.temperature_note: Map shows R1 (constituent index 0 = temperature per NAMCON) on the horizontal grid; dry/land (-999) masked. Not causal proof vs DAS; model-frame context only.
viewer_hints.thermocline_note: thermocline_t is still exported but is mostly -999 in this run — use for specialist checks, not as the main viewer layer.
